in_sanskrit.name: दिम्बेश्वर
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of Knowledge, God of the Poor
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the God of knowledge and the one who is the protector of the poor.

in_hindi.name: दिम्बेश्वर
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज्ञानपति (God of Knowledge) और प्राणार्थदाता (God of the Poor).

in_tamil.name: டிம்பேஷ்வர
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜ்ஞானம் பதிவிருப்பன் (God of Knowledge) அனுமதிக்குப் பரித்திரவர் (God of the Poor).

in_telugu.name: దిమ్బేశ్వర
in_telugu.long_meaning: జ్ఞానపతి (God of Knowledge) అనుమోదేశ్వర (God of the Poor).

in_marathi.name: Dimbeswar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dimbeswar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit ‘Dhimba’ meaning ‘earth’ and ‘Ishwar’ meaning ‘God’. Dimbeswar is the deity of the earth and the protector of agriculture.

in_bengali.name: Dimbeswar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dimbeswar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit ‘Dhimba’ meaning ‘earth’ and ‘Ishwar’ meaning ‘God’. Dimbeswar is the deity of the earth and the protector of agriculture.
